versions.changelog:
- Added a YAML front-matter block with a name, expanded description, and multilingual keywords to SKILL.md.
- Clarified that the tool is AI-driven and highlighted use cases for agencies, brands, sellers, and content ops teams.
- Included Chinese terms for batch video production and content automation in the description.
- No functional changes to core capabilities or usage; documentation only.

- Initial release of Batch Video Creator.
- Enables mass generation of unique short video variants from a single source.
- Features automated caption generation, hook rotation, voiceover and color grading diversity.
- Ensures videos are platform-deduplication safe using a 6-layer uniqueness system.
- Supports batch export with platform-specific formatting and organization.
